title: Join (group items): Join radio inputs with btn style (daisyUI)
notes:
Join is a container for grouping multiple items, it can be used to group buttons, inputs, etc. Join applies border radius to the first and last item. Join can be used to create a horizontal or vertical list of items.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/join/+page.md
